versions.name: Camp Miles (Price-Sanders Scout Reservation)

features.note: The camp page lists aquatics as a bookable program area without naming individual activities.
Scouts can attend winter camp individually as provisional campers.
Shooting ranges are bookable, without individual disciplines named.
Welding and metalworking are taught among the camp's trade skills badges.

versions.summary: Southwest Florida Council's 1,200-acre Scouts BSA resident camp near Punta Gorda, featuring a pool, rifle, shotgun, archery, and BB ranges, a climbing wall, rappelling tower, ropes course, and waterfront.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
